title: Gravity and Matter from Soldered Chiral Superconnections
summary: We present a reformulation of four-dimensional chiral gravity in terms of a chiral gauge connection and a Clifford-valued coframe. The exterior algebra generated by $e^a γ_a$, together with the gauge curvature $F$, provides a natural and systematic construction of gauge-covariant differential forms. We show that suitable combinations of the chiral actions reproduce Einstein--Cartan--Holst gravity with a cosmological term.
